title: Automated Tomographic 4D-STEM Data Acquisition Workflow Connected with Ptychographic High-Resolution 3D Reconstruction
content: Manual tomographic 4D-STEM data acquisition requires continuous user intervention for alignment, focus, and tilt adjustments, making it time-consuming and prone to errors. Additionally, prolonged exposure for focusing and manual tracking increases radiation dose, while delays between acquisitions introduce drift, degrading reconstructions. Additionally, the 3D potential volume reconstruction using ptychographic atomic electron tomography usually happens after the experiment session, inconsistent data acquisition will result in degradation of result quality, or even failure of reconstruction.
